description: Add one fixed asset to the register and return its id with the rate, useful life and convention taken from the bundled tax table. Cost and residual are whole minor units. Free tier holds ten assets.

category.description: A code or name from the bundled table, e.g. "487" or "Computers and computer sets" (pl), "main" (uk), "5-year" (us). Read assets://categories for the list

cost_minor.description: Acquisition cost in MINOR units (integer cents/grosze), e.g. 549900 for 5499.00. Never a decimal

currency.description: ISO code. Defaults to the shared business profile currency, else the scheme table currency

declining_coefficient.description: Declining-balance coefficient. Polish default 2.0, capped by the table; ignored with straight-line

in_service_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset entered use and the register. Defaults to purchase_date

life_years.description: Override the useful life derived from the table, in years. The answer reports that it was an override

method.description: "straight-line" or "declining-balance". Default: the table row method, straight-line for the Polish annex and the reducing-balance pool rate for the UK

name.description: What the asset is, e.g. "MacBook Pro 16" or "Delivery van"

project.description: Project, department or cost centre this asset belongs to

purchase_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset was bought

rate_pct.description: Override the annual percentage derived from the table. Use for a lowered Polish rate under art. 16i

residual_minor.description: Residual or salvage value in MINOR units, default 0. Must be less than cost. MACRS ignores it and the answer says so

scheme.description: "pl" Polish KST annex rates, "uk" HMRC capital allowance pools, "us" IRS MACRS GDS. Omit to derive it from the shared business profile currency

name: asset_add
title: Add a fixed asset
